properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.capture-arguments
properties.description: Enable the capture of Logback log event arguments.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.capture-template
properties.description: Enable the capture of the Logback log event message template (if arguments are provided).

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.capture-code-attributes
properties.description: Enable the capture of source code attributes. Note that capturing source code attributes at logging sites might add a performance overhead.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.capture-experimental-attributes
properties.description: Enable the capture of experimental log attributes 'thread.name' and 'thread.id'.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.capture-marker-attribute
properties.description: Enable the capture of Logback markers as attributes.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.structured-attributes.included
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the keys of structured log attributes to capture: SLF4J key-value pairs, Logstash markers, and Logstash structured arguments. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence. Nothing is captured when both included and excluded are empty.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.structured-attributes.excluded
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the keys of structured log attributes not to capture: SLF4J key-value pairs, Logstash markers, and Logstash structured arguments. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. Configuring only excluded patterns captures every key they do not match.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.mdc-attributes.included
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the MDC keys to capture as log attributes. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence. Nothing is captured when both included and excluded are empty.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.mdc-attributes.excluded
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the MDC keys not to capture as log attributes. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. Configuring only excluded patterns captures every key they do not match.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.logger-context-attributes.included
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the Logback logger context property keys to capture as log attributes. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence. Nothing is captured when both included and excluded are empty.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.logger-context-attributes.excluded
properties.description: Case-sensitive glob patterns for the Logback logger context property keys not to capture as log attributes. '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. Configuring only excluded patterns captures every key they do not match.

properties.name: arconia.otel.logs.logback-bridge.num-logs-captured-before-otel-install
properties.description: Log telemetry is emitted after the initialization of the OpenTelemetry Logback appender with an OpenTelemetry object. This setting allows you to modify the size of the cache used to replay the first logs. 'thread.id' attribute is not captured.
